_comment: Delivering the dead god's letter to the Verdant. The first god-questline opener.
WORLD.md, locked: 'The Verdant / Rill -- the one who covered. During an older crisis
it took over the overworld's duties and never quite handed them back; the estrangement
is professional rather than personal, which is worse. Delivered its letter it is
immediately DEFENSIVE: it assumes it is being blamed, before anyone has said anything.'
So the scene opens with the Verdant already mid-argument. Nobody has accused it of
anything. Nobody has said a word. It has been rehearsing this for a very long time and
the players walked into the middle of it -- which is the characterization, delivered as
a structural fact rather than as a line about its feelings.
THE NAME IS NOT IN THIS FILE, and that is load-bearing rather than an oversight.
The reveal WORLD.md builds on the letters is that the mail uses names the player has
never heard, and `tools/letters_check.py` asserts categorically that the three names
appear in their own letters and NOWHERE else in the shipped string table. A delivery
scene is the single most tempting place to break that -- the god is literally being
handed a letter addressed to it -- and it would land as recognition instead of as a
stranger's correspondence. So the Verdant reacts to being addressed that way without
ever repeating the word, which is the stronger beat anyway: 'nobody has called me that
since' does more than the name would.
Dread covenant: the permitted comedy is the SYSTEM. What is funny is that a god's
answer to a bereavement is a coverage dispute -- an arrangement, a handover that never
happened, an unreturned duty. It is played completely straight and nobody winks. The
grief in the letter is never the punchline; the Verdant's defensiveness is, and the
Verdant does not know it is being funny.
Rules: INITIATOR for the Verdant's own beats. VOTE where the group decides how to
treat it, because that is a judgement about a person. UNANIMOUS on 'tell it the
letter is not about the arrangement at all' -- that one takes away the defence it has
been holding for a thousand years, and nobody should be able to do that alone. Same
reasoning as the shrine-keeper's one cruelty.
Regard: VERDANT throughout, this being its scene. Letting it finish costs nothing and
earns a little -- it has not been listened to in a long time. Pressing the blame it
assumed is the expensive one. Note there is NO path that makes it comfortable: the
estrangement is professional, and professional estrangements do not resolve in one
conversation.
